data_description.logikplan_plan_prefix: Prefix for auto-created cluster plans. Plans are named like: HA - Marker [1-100].
data_description.logikplan_max_pairs_per_plan: How many Web-IO + marker pairs fit into one managed plan before a new cluster plan is created. For IO cluster plans this maps to 1 (50), 2 (100) or 3 (150) extensions per plan. KNX cluster plans ignore this setting and always use a fixed size of 50.
data_description.logikplan_io_extensions: Each selected extension gets its IOs wired into a managed IO cluster plan (e.g. HA - IO [Ext]), one column per extension. Start with a single extension to test, then add the others.
data_description.ignored_markers: Comma-, semicolon-, space- or dot-separated marker IDs and ranges, with or without 'M' prefix (e.g. '123, 456; 789' or 'M123, M456' or '8-12'). Only markers with a description can be ignored.
data_description.ignored_knx: Comma-, semicolon-, space- or dot-separated KNX object IDs and ranges, with or without 'K' prefix (e.g. '123, 456; 789' or 'K123, K456' or '8-12'). Only KNX objects with a description can be ignored.
data_description.function_plan_backup_retention_months: Once the newest backup of a plan that was deleted directly in Comexio is older than this, a repair asks whether to delete or keep that plan's backups — nothing is deleted without your confirmation. A live plan's backups are never affected. The 'Function Plan Purge Orphaned Backups' action deletes all expired ones at once.
data_description.bus_watchdog_enabled: On a sustained bus-load rise, automatically restart the HA-managed cluster function plans (back to front) to try to relieve it. Non-destructive to the Comexio system itself.
data_description.bus_watchdog_auto_reboot: If the bus load averages above 90% for 5 minutes, trigger an IMMEDIATE, unconfirmed full Comexio system reboot. Off by default — enable only once you trust the watchdog.
data_description.function_plan_watchdog_notify: Notify services (e.g. notify.mobile_app_your_phone) that get a push when an HA-managed function plan stops. The push has a 'Start plan' button, and is removed again once the plan runs. Leave empty for no push; the repair is raised either way.
data_description.function_plan_watchdog_user_plans: User plans (not managed by Home Assistant) that should always run. The watchdog treats them like the HA plans: repair, problem sensor and push when one stops. The Plan Auto-Start (user plans) switch starts them again on its own. Leave plans you stop on purpose (tests) out.

uninstall_cleanup.title: Uninstall Cleanup
uninstall_cleanup.description:
Choose what to remove from Comexio. In total, the integration created {plan_count} Function Plan(s), {device_count} Web-IO device(s), and {class_count} Web-IO class(es).

* **Everything** removes all of it.
* **Markers only / IOs only / KNX only** remove just that part's Function Plans, Web-IO device and class. The shared trigger plan is only removed as a whole if it holds no trigger pairs of the other category — otherwise Markers/KNX remove just their own pairs from it.
* **KNX only** and **Everything** also clear the titles of the KNX bridge markers, so they become free markers again. The markers themselves are not deleted.

This cannot be undone. Deleted Function Plans lose their wiring permanently.

uninstall_cleanup.title: KNX pre-release cleanup
uninstall_cleanup.description:
This installation still contains KNX Function Plans or Web-IO devices from a KNX pre-release (v0.10.0-rc1 to rc3). Their layout no longer matches this version.

**KNX only** (preselected) removes the KNX Function Plans, the KNX Web-IO device and class and the KNX loopback Web-IO, and clears the titles of the KNX bridge markers so they can be reused. The next sync then rebuilds everything cleanly. Marker and IO plans are not touched; from the shared trigger plan only the KNX trigger pairs are removed (the whole plan only if it holds nothing else).

This cannot be undone. Choose Cancel to keep everything as it is.

duplicate_plan_names.title: Duplicate Comexio plan names
duplicate_plan_names.description:
Two or more function plans share the exact same name: {plans}.

Comexio doesn't enforce unique plan names — only the internal plan ID actually is unique — but this integration resolves plans by name in several places (Connect, Sort, Restore, …). With duplicate names, a name-based lookup could silently target the wrong plan.

You can technically leave it like this and nothing breaks today, but it's a latent risk — especially for `function_plan_restore`, if that plan is ever deleted and needs restoring. **Recommendation: rename one of the duplicates in Comexio Studio** to remove the ambiguity for good.

knx_dpt_suffix.title: Classify KNX object
knx_dpt_suffix.description:
**{name}** ({remaining} more after this one) uses a KNX DPT1.x subtype (Schalter/Bool/Freigabe/Flanke/Binärwert) that KNX allows to wire as a real toggle switch, a momentary push-button (Taster), or a read-only status readback — the datapoint type alone can't tell which, only you know the actual wiring.

How should this object be treated?

orphaned_backups.title: Backups of a deleted function plan
orphaned_backups.description:
Comexio has no function plan **{plan_name}** under ID {fub_id} any more — it was deleted or renamed. Plan now using ID {fub_id}: **{current_plan}**. If that is this plan under a new name, its newer backups are stored under that name; these are the ones from before.

Its {count} backup(s) are kept for {months} month(s) after the newest one ({newest}) — that period has passed.

**Keep** keeps these backups and never asks again for this plan. You can still delete them later with the **Function Plan Delete Backups** action.
**Delete** removes them for good.

**Load into the plan preview** shows the newest backup in the plan card (the **Plan** selector switches to **Orphaned plans**) without deciding anything — this repair stays open. There you can also browse, restore (as a new plan), delete or keep them. To see what the plan contained first: Developer tools → Actions → **Function Plan Visualize**, field **Snapshot** → pick an entry starting with **{plan_name} — fub {fub_id}**. More in the [backup guide]({docs_url}).

function_plan_stopped.title: Managed function plan stopped
function_plan_stopped.description:
The function plan **{plan_name}** (ID {fub_id}) is managed by Home Assistant, but it is not running in Comexio. The markers, IOs, KNX objects or triggers it connects do not reach Home Assistant until it runs again.

**Submit** starts the plan now. To have the integration start such a plan on its own, turn on the **Plan Auto-Start (HA plans)** switch on the function plan device.

function_plan_stopped.title: Watched user plan stopped
function_plan_stopped.description:
The user plan **{plan_name}** (ID {fub_id}) is watched by the function plan watchdog, but it is not running in Comexio.

**Submit** starts the plan now. To have the integration start such a plan on its own, turn on the **Plan Auto-Start (user plans)** switch on the function plan device. To stop watching it, remove it from the integration options.
